blocks.text: Match preview: Hong Kong, China face Oman in 3rd Place Play-off (ODI) on Sat, 12 Sept, 2026, 7:00 am at YSD-UKM Cricket Oval Bangi. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Standard ODI surface expected. Conditions will be clearer at the toss — monitor team selection and dew factor for night games.
Expected par score: 250–290 runs par score.
Rain showers · High 31°C / Low 24°C · Rain: 8.7 mm · Wind: up to 12 km/h. Rain likely — DLS may apply; favour bowlers who hit the deck and teams with depth.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
